show: The Charlie Brown and Snoopy Show

eps.d: Charlie Brown can't pitch, Sally's struggles in school, Charlie Brown and Peppermint Patty share a desk, Lucy finds new ways to annoy Schroder. Lastly Snoopy, Linus, and Woodstock fight the cat next door for Linus' blanket.
Lucy's garden, Re-Run's life, Linus looses his blanket, and Snoopy manages the baseball team.
Sally gets Snoopy's help with a school assignment, the gang plays football and plays in the snow, Lucy fawns over Schroder, Charlie has a kite flying fiasco, and the various ways Lucy tortures Linus.

Lucy has to put up with a lot; but she can also dish it out with the best of them whether it's playing baseball, or putting up with her brother. Other stories include Peppermint Patty staying at Charlie Brown's house and Snoopy is nominated for an award.
Linus gives his blanket away; Peppermint Patty and Charlie Brown get into a fight at school; Schroeder fears that his piano-playing days are over.
Snoopy is a complex dog. Various stories include his amorous side, his playful side, his role as a protector, a watchdog, and even a rescue dog.

Lucy picks on Charlie Brown driving him to seek help from Snoopy. Charlie Brown and Linus try to fly a kite. Peppermint Patty and Snoopy go to a dance. Thiebault borrows Charlie Brown's baseball mitt and then insults Peppermint Patty and Marcie.
Charlie Brown and Snoopy discuss puppy training, Rerun contributes to the baseball team, Lucy and Linus play in the snow, and Peppermint Patty and Marcie in school among many others.
Charlie Brown walks funny, Marcie finds her mean streak after a boy develops a crush on her, Linus and Snoopy go truffle hunting, and Charlie Brown's team suffers setback after setback.

Peppermint Patty is accused of stealing her teacher's gold stars and she enlists Snoopy's help. Linus claims someone stole his blanket. Schroder's piano playing elicits many varied reactions. The gang tries to teach each other how to play football.
There's "Chaos in the Classroom" when Sally brings Woodstock's nest to school for show and tell. And there's chaos on the field when Linus tries to teach Sally to play football.

eps.t: It's That Team Spirit, Charlie Brown
eps.d: Snoopy uses various techniques to get Linus' blanket. Peppermint Patty continues to struggle in school. Re-Run goes for a ride on his mother's bicycle. Charlie Brown tries to coach his baseball team.

Charlie Brown tangles with the Kite-Eating Tree. Snoopy eats Sally's homework. The gang goes to summer camp. Lucy fawns over Schroder unsuccessfully. Something that goes bump in the night scares Snoopy, so he seeks help from Lucy.

Snoopy breaks his foot and must wear a cast. Meanwhile, Woodstock grows a beanstalk to the sky, where he and Snoopy meet a cookie-hoarding giant. Finally, the youngest of the Van Pelts has to deal with various problems.
Peppermint Patty asks Charlie Brown for help with her team. Linus waits up for the Great Pumpkin while Charlie Brown and Peppermint Patty go bowling. Snoopy's older brother Spike vists.

The gang goes to computer camp. Linus starts a clinic for kids with security blankets. Snoopy goes to visit Spike in the desert. Charlie Brown and Peppermint Patty go on a date. Later Marcie and Peppermint Patty both develop a crush on Charlie Brown.

Peppermint Patty's struggles in school are chronicled. Snoopy's develops a cool trick after his antics begin to wear on the kids' nerves. Schroeder doesn't know how to get to piano camp. The gang flies him there on Snoopy's doghouse.
Charlie Brown reflects on his most memorable Christmas while Sally and Lucy prepare for Valentine's Day and Peppermint Patty writes an award-winning essay on Snoopy.
